messages:
Nora Diaz: starting rollout v4.0.2 in APAC during the 02:00 change window. Noted small p95 blip after canary.
Ethan Brooks: saw it, ~200ms on rerank path for apac-sg. deploy-bot also reported 1.8% 5xx increase.
deploy-bot: ALERT: p95_latency_above_threshold AND error_rate_increase -> recommend: hold rollout and consider regional rollback. Auto-rollback suppressed due to "enterprise-pin" flag. :warning:
Nora Diaz: ok hold. Are we leaning manual rollback for APAC only?
Ethan Brooks: yes. Suggest pin v4.0.1 in apac-sg and shift traffic. Quick commands:
```
releasectl pin-version --region=apac-sg --version=4.0.1 --reason="canary-p95-regression"
releasectl traffic shift --region=apac-sg --from=4.0.2 --to=4.0.1 --weight=100 --dry-run
```
Run dry-run then execute.
Nora Diaz: running dry-run now.
Nora Diaz: dry-run clean. executing at 6365000045.
ops-bot: NOTICE: traffic shift executed at 6365000045. Monitoring p95 and 5xx for 15m.
Ethan Brooks: p95 back to baseline after 5m, 5xx down. Looks stable.
release-coordinator-bot: MARK: change-window 02:00-03:00 impacted=true, note added to release notes: "APAC partial rollback to 4.0.1 due to canary latency spike. Full rollout paused." Notifying account-ops for Dedicated tenants.
Nora Diaz: customer blurb (for #status): "We paused the APAC rollout of v4.0.2 after elevated latency for a subset of requests. APAC has been reverted to v4.0.1 while we investigate. No customer-facing errors expected. Follow-up in 1h."
Ethan Brooks: I'll add a regression test for the rerank path that covers the config we changed. Also opening a ticket to make auto-rollback respect enterprise-pin with an ops approval flow.
Nora Diaz: thanks. We'll reconvene for postmortem in 1h. :coffee:
